name: bloghub
description: An open-source, full-stack publishing platform engineered for deep reading, live Markdown authoring, read-through engagement analytics, and complete platform governance.

scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix client run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix client run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix client run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix client run format:check
